title_blind_and_negative_neighbor.title_blind_test: Strip all titles and identifiers: the text systematically guides an evaluator through task-level individual baseline measurement, post-training cooldown tracking on identical tasks, skill demonstration vs job outcome separation, confounder isolation, and individual follow-up intervention. This uniquely matches TTQS Indicator 19 Tier 3 item E17 ('相關證據顯示個人訓練後之績效改善成果').

negative_neighbor_distinctions.differentiation: Candidate explicitly clarifies in Section 壹-二 and Header that individual job task accuracy is strictly distinguished from compensation and promotion, disallowing wage growth as a proxy for job performance.
Candidate distinguishes individual task performance from external market value, customer satisfaction, or macro business indicators in Section 壹-二.

Candidate differentiates classroom skill demonstrations (33/60 -> 48/60) from job KPI accuracy (93/120 -> 101/120) across Sections 貳-二, 參, 肆-三, and 玖-三, explicitly barring satisfaction surveys or test scores from standing in as workplace KPIs.

findings: Complete semantic fidelity to Source Packet 0128 and Unique Blueprint R01.
Full mathematical precision across individual and aggregate rows, with correct weighted pooled rates (+6.67 pp) instead of unweighted means.
Preservation of negative and neutral cases (S-EMP-03 declined by -5 pp, S-EMP-06 remained unchanged at 85%), demonstrating genuine evaluation rigor without survivorship bias.
Clean structural bifurcation between the synthetic explanatory case report (Sections 壹-捌) and the blank operational form (Section 玖).
Exemplary governance posture: disclaims unverified causality, asserts no official common numeric threshold, supplies RR-01 to RR-12 replacement register, and leaves signature blocks blank.
limitations: Review is strictly semantic and textual, based on candidate extracted text and input source packets.
Binary DOCX layout, fonts, margins, page breaks, and visual rendering were excluded from this semantic review scope.
No live external organizational database, LMS, or HRIS records were queried; review confirms adherence to CANDIDATE status.
